crisis.title: Crisis Communication
crisis.tagline: Protect trust when the pressure is highest.
crisis.intro: Mining operations can face incidents, community tensions, regulatory issues, environmental concerns or rapidly evolving media narratives. Effective crisis communication requires preparation long before a crisis begins.
crisis.metaDescription: Crisis preparedness, media response and stakeholder communication for mining companies facing incidents, community tensions or regulatory scrutiny.

media.title: Media Relations & Spokesperson Strategy
media.tagline: Be represented with clarity and authority.
media.intro: Coverage of mining is shaped by journalists, analysts and commentators who rarely have time to seek context. Strong media relationships and well-prepared spokespeople determine whether your position is heard accurately.
media.metaDescription: Media strategy, press relations and spokesperson training that give mining executives a clear, credible voice with journalists and the public.

esg.title: ESG, CSR & Social Licence to Operate
esg.intro: Investors, regulators and communities increasingly judge mining companies on evidence rather than intention. ESG communication has to connect what an organisation does with what its stakeholders can verify.
esg.metaTitle: ESG & Social Licence Communication for Mining
esg.metaDescription: Turn ESG and CSR commitments into credible narratives and reporting that strengthen a mining project's social licence to operate.

community.title: Community Relations
community.tagline: Build dialogue where operations meet people.
community.intro: Local communities live with the daily reality of a mining project. Sustained, honest dialogue is what turns consultation into trust, and trust into a durable licence to operate.
community.metaDescription: Stakeholder mapping, local consultation and grievance communication that build lasting dialogue between mining operations and communities.

financial.title: Financial Communication
financial.tagline: Communicate value to the people who fund it.
financial.intro: Investors, lenders and partners assess mining projects through disclosure, guidance and management credibility. Financial communication must be precise, consistent and aligned with operational reality.
financial.metaDescription: Investor messaging, results communication and capital markets narratives that help mining companies explain value, risk and strategy.

digital.title: Digital Reputation & Monitoring
digital.tagline: Know how you are seen before it matters.
digital.intro: Perception now forms online, often faster than an organisation can respond. Continuous monitoring turns scattered signals into early warning, and early warning into time to act.
digital.metaDescription: Online reputation audits, media and social monitoring and early issue detection to protect how your mining company is perceived online.

hero.intro: Behind every lasting reputation are people who understand what is at stake.

thomas.name: Thomas d'Aquin MOANANG
thomas.headline: Where scientific understanding meets strategic communication.
thomas.intro: A strategic communicator with over 15 years of experience in reputation, brand strategy and development communication.
biography: Thomas d'Aquin MOANANG is a senior communications professional with more than 15 years of experience in strategic planning, institutional communication and brand reputation. His work brings together the analysis of audiences, communication strategy and the coordination of integrated campaigns.

Originally trained in geology and applied geophysics, he brings a distinctive understanding of technical and industrial environments. His professional experience includes communication assignments across telecommunications, cement manufacturing, financial services and development initiatives.

experiences.title: Strategic communication and campaign coordination
experiences.description: Account Director responsible for coordinating strategic communication, integrated campaigns and brand communication activities for MTN Cameroon.

experiences.title: France Alumni — development communication
experiences.description: Contribution to the France Alumni initiative in Douala through the development of a temporary media studio, interviews, audiovisual productions and communication activities around the blue economy.

experiences.title: 10th anniversary communication campaign
experiences.description: Communication strategy and creative production activities supporting the company's tenth-anniversary campaign in Cameroon.
